summary: Charles Leclerc won the Monaco Grand Prix from pole position, 7.2s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Valtteri Bottas made the biggest climb, from P17 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag.
The stewards penalised OCO (10 second time penalty).
There were 23 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 31 points over Charles Leclerc.
